status: Prospective exploratory extension registered after full L7/L7B interpretation, before new fits. Previously examined human; not a preregistered independent validation.
question: Does source temporal ordering improve adaptation beyond source-matched amplitudes and cross-filter Gram structure?
real_reference: Reuse original audited L7 real_linear_s0/1/2 for identical files/budgets; do not refit or select seeds.

controls.reversed: For each seed reverse all25taps of its exact real frozen bank. Preserves row Gram, row norms, singular values and original adjacent-tap roughness; remains causal but reverses recent/distant lag weighting.
controls.gram_random: For each real seed construct L=Cholesky(GG.T), Q=positive-diagonal thin QR of25x5Gaussian matrix from NumPydefault_rng([20261011,801,seed]); nullbank=L@Q.T. Preserves exact row Gram/norms/spectrum with random temporal orientation. Roughness need not match.

adaptation: Immutable original L7.job: support-only step0ridgegrid,150Adamupdates,sameLOO objective/checkpoints/supportselection/smoothing/normclipping. No query-based choices.
comparisons: Real mean over3seeds minus each control mean overthe same3pairedseeds; allbudgets and all8original checkpoint summaries, six-date10000draw bootstrap, conditional and unadjusted. No selective3-budget/seed headline.
null_information: Both controls use the learned real-source filters and thus source supervision, statistics and real-source selection. They are perturbation controls, not source-free models.
limits: Real-versus-null difference tests the specified perturbation, not conservation or all generic strategies.
Matching initial Gram does not match subsequent target feature variance, effective penalty or optimization path.
Reversal matches initial smoothness only; behavior-dependent dynamics can change covariance.
No newhuman; incremental labels conditional on prior H1-informed development.
No independent replay of every gradient update.
preflight: Independent bank algebra/reconstruction plus all3budgets/all6nullinitializations on4alreadyexamined macaque stand-in files. Independent rawprediction/selection/refit/bootstrap audit must pass before any newhumanfit.
execution: CPUonly,8spawn workers viaProcessPoolExecutor; per-fit atomic records/predictions retained. A native worker death fails the executor rather than hanging on a lost pool task. Refuse overwrite or implicit retry.
